mapper.insert: insert into site (site_id, region_id, name, region, address, sido, sigungu, eupmyeondong, contact_phone, create_time) values (#{siteId,jdbcType=CHAR}, #{regionId,jdbcType=CHAR}, #{name,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{region,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{address,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{sido,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{sigungu,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{eupmyeondong,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{contactPhone,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP})
mapper.update: update site set region_id = #{regionId,jdbcType=CHAR}, name = #{name,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, region = #{region,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, address = #{address,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, sido = #{sido,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, sigungu = #{sigungu,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, eupmyeondong = #{eupmyeondong,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, contact_phone = #{contactPhone,jdbcType=VARCHAR} where site_id = #{siteId,jdbcType=CHAR}
mapper.select: select site_id, region_id, name, region, address, sido, sigungu, eupmyeondong, contact_phone, create_time from site where site_id = #{siteId,jdbcType=CHAR}
select site_id, region_id, name, region, address, sido, sigungu, eupmyeondong, contact_phone, create_time from site

select s.site_id, s.region_id, s.name, s.region, s.address, s.sido, s.sigungu, s.eupmyeondong, s.contact_phone, s.create_time, count(h.household_id) as total_households, count(distinct h.dong) as dong_count, count(case when h.install_status = 'INSTALLED' then 1 end) as completed_households from site s left join household h on s.site_id = h.site_id
and s.sido = #{sido}
and ( s.sigungu = #{sigungu} or s.sigungu like concat(#{sigungu}, '%') or #{sigungu} like concat(s.sigungu, '%') or s.region = #{sigungu} or s.region like concat(#{sigungu}, '%') )
and s.eupmyeondong like concat('%', #{eupmyeondong}, '%')
and (s.name like concat('%', #{query}, '%') or s.address like concat('%', #{query}, '%'))
group by s.site_id order by s.create_time desc

select s.site_id, s.region_id, s.name, s.region, s.address, s.sido, s.sigungu, s.eupmyeondong, s.contact_phone, s.create_time, h.household_id as hh_id, h.site_id as hh_site_id, h.dong as hh_dong, h.ho as hh_ho, h.head_name as hh_head_name, h.target_type as hh_target_type, h.install_status as hh_install_status, h.remarks as hh_remarks, h.create_time as hh_create_time, (select count(*) from household where site_id = s.site_id) as total_households, (select count(distinct dong) from household where site_id = s.site_id) as dong_count, (select count(*) from household where site_id = s.site_id and install_status = 'INSTALLED') as completed_households from site s left join household h on s.site_id = h.site_id where s.site_id = #{siteId} order by h.dong asc, h.ho asc
